note: Fixed scenes for tools/perf/device_session.ps1. 'args' are written one per line to the perf APK's user://perf_args.txt (02 P10 contract, 08-performance-to-02-engine.md). seconds = measured time after settle_s. Same round seed every time (autoplay uses the data's deterministic seed). zoom_on scenes set 02's project flag game/camera/world_zoom_plus_one through the perf arg --world-zoom-plus-one; the expected camera zoom is (k+1)/k with k = the device's canvas scale (4/3 on 1080-high, 3/2 on 720-high phones). If the game reports another zoom the scene is marked ZOOM_NOT_APPLIED.
